items.title: More than 60 chances to train every week
items.summary: Classes that fit around real life, backed by 11 coaches and a community that keeps the standard high.
items.take: Consistency gets easier when the right people are waiting for you on the floor.

items.title: Two ways into Elation
items.summary: Small Group PT plus unlimited classes is £100 per month. Unlimited classes is £75 per month.
items.take: Pick the support you need, then turn up and put the work in.

items.title: Elite experience on the gym floor
items.summary: Two Elite 15 owners, Graham Halliday and Matt Agnew, coach alongside the Elation team in Glasgow.
items.take: Elite standards are useful only when they help everyday athletes make real progress.
